images.name: 余烬·破阙
images.design: RED BROADCUT short military saber. A broad stocky almost rectangular single-edged blade with a smooth slightly convex outer cutting edge and a dramatic slanted guillotine point, like a sculpted futuristic falchion. Width increases gradually toward the upper third, conveying compact heft. Exactly TWO large rectangular recesses cut into the straight rear spine, like architectural crenellations, while the broad main cutting face remains unbroken and solid. No V-shaped notch, no round hole, no zigzag pointed teeth. Lower blade root is a wide diagonal shoulder. Compact closed angular knuckle guard forms a stout trapezoidal frame beside the short grip, with plenty of space for fingers, squared clipped-corner pommel. Deep scarlet faces, vermilion with slight coral edge emission; tiny square red ember motes near the two rectangular recesses. Distinct wide short cutlass silhouette, roughly blade five palm lengths and grip one palm length. Substantial clean faceted planes.

images.name: 流萤·穿岚
images.design: GREEN STREAMLANCE single-handed thrusting sword. Extremely elegant narrow straight triangular-section blade, tapering continuously to a precise needle point. ONE long slim auxiliary aerodynamic fin grows from the lower blade on one side, sweeps outward into a clean shallow crescent and returns to touch the spine halfway up, making a single long teardrop negative space alongside the lower blade, not a hole punched inside it. The core blade is a solid straight slender triangular prism, not a flimsy wire. Lower fin transitions organically into a compact asymmetrical swept crescent guard above the hand, no enclosed knuckle guard. Short straight one-palm grip, flattened streamlined spindle pommel. Jade-green core with mint and turquoise ridges. Three or four tiny thin green needle motes near the tip. No S-curved main blade, no leaf-shaped broad saber, no feathers, no vine textures. A light precise fencing sword from geometric solid energy.

images.name: 寒汐·环衡
images.design: BLUE ECCENTRIC ring-root arming sword. One straight broad double-edged blade with a long faceted spear tip. The blade's lower quarter opens into ONE strongly off-center hollow octagonal ring, deliberately shifted to the LEFT of the blade axis. A wide continuous RIGHT spine joins the short grip to the solid upper blade beside this ring, carrying the silhouette. The ring is integrated into the blade root rather than floating as a guard or a charm. Ring has thick beveled octagonal walls and empty center, no floating gem, no triangular central cutout. Blade upper two thirds remain one solid tapering flat prismatic blade with a distinct raised central ridge. Compact asymmetric guard has one low squared horizontal quillon to the right and a short curved elbow to the left under the ring; short single-palm blue grip and squat octagonal pommel. Rich ocean blue broad planes and cyan/turquoise edge lighting. Sparse tiny cyan hollow ring particles close to the off-center aperture. Strongly asymmetric lower architecture and clean straight point.

images.name: 梦隙·开屏
images.design: PURPLE FANBLADE one-handed sword. ONE coherent broad pointed sword silhouette built from exactly THREE long tapering solid triangular blade plates arranged like a narrowly opened folding fan. They all start from the SAME compact collar above the guard and overlap across their lower two thirds, with small progressively offset depths. Central-left plate reaches the longest point, middle plate ends a little lower, outer-right plate ends at about three quarters blade height, creating three descending sharp tips close together along a slanted crown; overall reads as a broad bladed sword rather than three separate swords or a fork. No horizontal bridge bars, no parallel rectangular rails, no spiral. The plates fan through a modest 18-degree total angle; wide clean purple facets and long lavender bevels reveal layered thickness and two deep shadow seams. Guard a compact single half-disc fan of three folded triangular facets oriented downward away from blade; usable short straight one-palm grip, small oblique triangular prism pommel. Deep plum and violet faces with lilac and pink-violet edges. A few tiny purple triangular flakes near the staggered tips. Architectural folded fan aesthetic, sharp and substantial.
